help._pestanas: The tabs at the top are PC types: «All» applies to any PC and is the one to use. «BIOS only», «UEFI only»… set a different value just for that boot type. A red dot means that tab has data.
help._guardado: Changes are saved instantly to the USB (ventoy.json file) and a backup is made when this window opens (ventoy_backup.json). If you are not sure what to change, leave it alone: PoxiISO comes already configured.
help.plugson_main: Here you see your USB's details. In the menu on the left you can customize how the boot menu behaves.
help.plugson_control: General menu settings: language, timeouts, which file types are shown, how they are sorted and how it behaves with Windows 11.
help.plugson_theme: Boot menu look: theme, resolution and fonts. PoxiISO already ships its dark cyan theme; only touch this if you want to add another one. A wrong path can leave the menu without a theme.
help.plugson_menu_alias: Changes the name shown in the menu for each ISO or folder. For example, show "Win11_24H2_x64.iso" as "Windows 11".
help.plugson_menu_tip: Shows a help text on screen when you select a specific ISO or folder (for example, what that ISO is for).
help.plugson_menu_class: Assigns a type (windows, linux…) to an ISO or folder so the menu shows its icon. Icons depend on the theme.
help.plugson_auto_install: Unattended installs: links a template (for example a Windows autounattend.xml) to an ISO so it installs by itself.
help.plugson_persistence: For Linux systems in "live" mode: keeps your changes and files in a .dat file on the USB so they are not lost on shutdown.
help.plugson_injection: Puts an archive (.zip, .7z, .tar.gz…) inside an ISO at boot, without modifying the original ISO. For advanced users.
help.plugson_conf_replace: Replaces an ISO's boot configuration file with your own. This is an advanced setting: only use it if you know what you are doing.
help.plugson_password: Password-protects the menu or specific ISOs. Useful if you lend the USB. Note: it is not encryption, it only blocks booting from the menu.
help.plugson_image_list: Decides which ISOs are shown in the menu: allow mode (only the listed ones) or deny mode (all except the listed ones).
help.plugson_auto_memdisk: Forces certain small images to be fully loaded into memory (memdisk mode). Only for specific cases.
help.plugson_dud: DUD (Driver Update Disk): adds a driver disk when installing Red Hat or SUSE type distributions. This is an advanced setting.

tabs.note: This tab is not in use: what you see are the default values. At boot, the «All» settings apply. Only change something here if you want a different setting just for this type of PC.
